notes: Local immersion inventory complete: STSO-320 plus two of thirteen published electives, nine semester credit hours. This is a general-education immersion, not the separate AI in Society minor or a standalone degree. Transcript recognition remains unverified.

The normal public program page renders course rows and overview dynamically. Bare HTTP returns identity/plan/year but not the table. Source adapters do not interpret the missing HTTP table as empty requirements or overwrite the reviewed inventory; a rendered browser observation is needed for that source.
No immersion requirements were inferred from the minor. DHSS-488 and PHIL-320, present in the separate minor, are not in this immersion pool.

No program overlap is permitted; a corresponding minor can share some immersion coursework. Declaration is through SIS. Elective Pass/No Pass cannot fulfill immersion requirements. General transfer approval and applicable catalog rules are mapped.

D01.4 defines the immersion in semester credit hours. Only the required-course row independently states an individual amount (3); the two-elective group’s six hours is not converted into three credits for each of the thirteen options.

The 25% RIT residency rule applies to the host degree, not a separately invented immersion residency percentage. The audit covers the immersion and its relationship to the bachelor degree, not every host-degree requirement.

Academic catalog robots202/unavailable from the earlier pass was not retried. Ordinary public RIT pages and their browser-rendered course details were used. Launch date, elective course amounts, descriptions, prerequisites, public course sites and syllabi remain unverified.
